invariants.rationale: The method always returns a new HoodieWriteMetadata object, which is not null.
writeStatuses is always set using HoodieListData.eager so cannot be null.
The number of WriteStatus objects in the result matches the sum of WriteStatus produced by clustering per group.
Since clusteringPlan is always dereferenced, it cannot be null.
schema is passed in and assumed non-null per its use in clustering.
